provider.description: LLM provider used for new sessions.

model.description: Model identifier sent to the selected provider.

effort.description: Reasoning effort requested from models that support it.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate in one response.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of model and tool iterations allowed in one agent or subagent turn.

errorRetries.description: Number of retries for transient provider and network failures.

permissionMode.description: Controls whether Agav asks before tools perform sensitive actions.

allowedTools.description: Optional tool names or scoped tool patterns that may run without confirmation.

systemPrompt.description: Additional project-specific instructions included in the system prompt.
systemPrompt.eg: Follow the conventions documented in this repository.

hideAbsolutePath.description: Whether to hide absolute paths in terminal outputs, replacing them with relative ones.

showThinking.description: Whether to display the model's reasoning/thinking text as it streams. Toggle with Ctrl+T at runtime.

anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key. Prefer the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable for secrets.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key. Prefer the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable for secrets.

openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key. Prefer the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable for secrets.

nvidiaApiKey.description: NVIDIA NIM API key. Prefer the NVIDIA_API_KEY environment variable for secrets.

deepseekApiKey.description: DeepSeek API key. Prefer the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable for secrets.

openaiBaseURL.description: Override the OpenAI base URL to target an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Prefer the OPENAI_BASE_URL environment variable.

openaiHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every OpenAI-provider request. Useful for OpenAI-compatible gateways that need custom auth or routing headers.

geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key. Prefer the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable for secrets.

vertexAICredentialsPath.description: Path to a Google Cloud service-account JSON file used by Vertex AI. Setting it enables the provider. Prefer the VERTEX_AI_CREDENTIALS_PATH environment variable.

vertexAILocation.description: Vertex AI region, or "global" for the multi-region endpoint. Can also be set with VERTEX_AI_LOCATION.

ollamaEndpoint.description: Complete Ollama API base URL; overrides ollamaHost and ollamaPort.

ollamaHost.description: Ollama server hostname used when ollamaEndpoint is not configured.

ollamaPort.description: Ollama server port used when ollamaEndpoint is not configured.

ollamaApiKey.description: Optional bearer token for a secured or hosted Ollama endpoint.

hooks.description: Optional commands run after edits, after shell commands, or before commits.

theme.description: Optional terminal color and presentation overrides.

mcpServers.description: MCP server configurations keyed by the name shown inside Agav.
